measurement_definitions.webhook_ack_timer: Request arrival at ingress through signature verification and durable acceptance to acknowledgement.
measurement_definitions.burst_drain_timer: All tagged burst jobs reach approved terminal outcomes within 600 seconds of the last scheduled enqueue. Record scheduled and actual admission; delayed admission cannot extend the deadline.
measurement_definitions.terminal_outcomes: For provider doubles, successful terminal means the business effect and labelled acknowledgement are durable. Failed, discarded, unsubmitted and unresolved items do not count as drained.
measurement_definitions.action_endpoint_mapping: Frozen in BT500_ACTION_MAPPING.json; the mixed-staff runner tags each request and critical journey.
measurement_definitions.latency_observation_points: Client/generator action start through required parsed/durable result, including token refresh, request fan-out and retries; request latency is also reported separately.
measurement_definitions.error_denominators_and_rolling_failure_w: Unexpected failures divided by scheduled valid actions, split by phase, kind and journey; report steady aggregate and 60-second windows. Label negative/contention cases separately.
measurement_definitions.note: Freeze and approve all definitions before qualification. Failures, discarded work and simulated delivery cannot be relabelled as successful completion.

proposed_for_approval.action_latency: Measure from client action initiation to required visible result; retain retries and backend fan-out in separate request metrics. Report each critical journey independently.
proposed_for_approval.valid_traffic_errors: Unexpected status, transport failure, timeout, invalid response or unmet normal-work outcome divided by all scheduled valid actions; report steady aggregate and60-second rolling windows. Expected negative/contention actions have separate tags and denominator.
proposed_for_approval.terminal_outcomes: For volume provider doubles, successful terminal means the business effect is committed and the explicitly labelled double acknowledgement is recorded. Failed, discarded, unsubmitted and unresolved items do not drain the successful burst. Genuine delivery is separate and unexecuted.
